meta.name: Mihajlo Estate - Editorial Luxury
meta.description: Design DNA for a premium Serbian real-estate agency. Dark cinematic hero, ivory and charcoal editorial body, one bronze accent, camera-like motion. Extracted from the references in docs/03-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md and reconciled with the project tokens in app/globals.css, which win on every conflict.
source_references: Sotheby's International Realty - restrained navy/ivory editorial grid, photography-first cards, serif wordmark with a hairline rule
The Agency - near-black chrome, oversized serif statements, wide letter-spaced wordmark, minimal chrome over full-bleed media
Aman - extreme whitespace, slow cross-fades, small tracked sans labels against very large serif headings, no shadows

Awwwards real-estate winners (ERA Residence, Belgrade Arbor by Square43, Silver Pinewood, Luxury Places, Carlin Residence Club) - pinned horizontal listing tracks, cursor-following imagery on location lists, clip-path image reveals, hairline draw-ins
meta.authority: app/globals.css > docs/03-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md > this file. Additions this file introduced are logged in docs/DECISIONS.md.

color.palette_type: Near-monochrome warm neutral with a single metallic accent

primary.role: ink - dark sections, primary text on light surfaces

secondary.role: ivory - the main light page background and text on ink

accent.role: bronze - links and active states on ink, hairlines, key figures. Never a large fill.

neutral.usage: ink / ink-2 / ink-3 are the dark surfaces and their hairlines; stone-text and stone are muted text and rules on light; mist is muted text on dark; ivory-2 is a raised light surface; paper is inputs and the lightest surface.

color.contrast_strategy: Every text/background pair is checked at WCAG AA for normal text, not just large text. Three tokens exist purely so AA holds on light surfaces: bronze-text #7A623C for accent text, stone-text #6C655B for muted text and warning-text #835F22. The bright bronze #B08D57 is only allowed on the ink family (5.19:1 on ink-3) or as a fill behind ink text (6.28:1). Depth never comes from a shadow - it comes from the photography, overlap and scale.

font_families.heading: Cormorant Garamond (300/400/500 + italic; latin, latin-ext, cyrillic)
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono 400 (latin, latin-ext, cyrillic) - reference codes, counters, coordinates only

typography.font_style_notes: Serif carries the voice; the sans carries the facts. Prices and every figure are tabular-nums lining-nums. Body measure stays under 68 characters, serif ledes under 52. Cyrillic and the Serbian diacritics must render in all three families, which is why every subset list includes cyrillic and latin-ext. Never set text-wrap: balance on an element SplitText will split.

spacing.base_unit: 4px (Tailwind default), with named rhythm tokens on top
spacing.content_density: Low. Whitespace is the luxury signal - a section is allowed to hold one sentence.
spacing.section_rhythm: 96px vertical on mobile, 160px from 1024px up. Gutters 24 / 32 / 48.

layout.grid_system: 12 columns, asymmetric editorial placements rather than centred blocks
layout.alignment_tendency: Left-aligned with deliberate offsets; captions overlap the image edge; oversized figures break the grid on purpose. Centring is reserved for the final CTA.

border_radius.pill: none - pills are banned on the public site

shape.border_usage: 1px hairlines only: ink at 12% on light, ivory at 12% on dark. A hairline is the primary structural device - it separates, frames and draws.
shape.divider_style: Full-bleed or column-width 1px rule that draws from 0 to 100% width on scroll

elevation.depth_cues: Overlap, scale change, an ink gradient scrim over the bottom 40% of dark-section imagery, and parallax rate differences

iconography.preferred_set: lucide-react, plus hand-authored SVG for the wordmark, the monogram and the scroll cue

motion.easing: CustomEase estate = cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for reveals; expo.out for hero lines; expo.inOut for curtains; power3.out for UI; linear for marquees and progress
motion.entrance_pattern: Masked line rise (yPercent 110 to 0, stagger 0.08), clip-path inset reveal for imagery, hairline draw for rules
motion.exit_pattern: Ink panel wipe upward on route change; overlays fade and scale from 0.97, never from 0
motion.philosophy: Motion is a camera move, not a transition library. GSAP owns scroll choreography and section reveals; every hover, menu and toast is a CSS transition under 300ms. Three matchMedia branches always exist: desktop pinning, a simpler mobile branch, and a reduced branch that paints the final state instantly.

components.button_style: Sharp 52px rectangle. Primary is ink-on-ivory or ivory-on-ink; secondary is a hairline outline; a bronze rule grows from the left on hover while the label shifts 2px. Active state scales to 0.98.
components.input_style: Underline only - no boxes. Paper background at most, a 1px bottom rule that turns bronze on focus, a label that floats up, and errors as red text plus an icon, never colour alone. 44px minimum touch target.
components.card_style: No border, no shadow, no radius. A 4:5 (landing) or 3:2 (search) photograph, the image scaling 1.04 to 1 over 700ms on hover, then price, meta row split by hairlines, and badges as uppercase text inside a hairline box.
components.navigation_pattern: Transparent header over the hero that solidifies to ink on scroll; a full-screen ink overlay menu on mobile with staggered serif items
components.modal_style: Full-bleed ink overlay or a bottom sheet; scale from 0.97 with opacity, centred origin, data-lenis-prevent on the scrollable body
components.list_style: Oversized serif rows separated by hairlines, the count in mono on the right, a cursor-following image on hover at desktop
components.component_notes: Every badge is text in a hairline box - no filled pills, no emoji, no drop shadows, no glassmorphism, no gradient decoration.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A printed architecture monograph opened under a warm lamp
aesthetic.era_influence: Swiss editorial grid discipline crossed with 1960s Italian architectural publishing

visual_language.complexity: Low element count, high craft per element
visual_language.ornamentation: Almost none. The only ornaments are the hairline and the bronze rule.
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous and deliberate - it is the product, not the leftover
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: One dominant photograph or one oversized serif line per viewport; everything else recedes
visual_language.focal_strategy: Scale contrast: a 9.5rem serif line beside 0.75rem tracked labels
visual_language.contrast_level: High in value, near-zero in hue
visual_language.texture_usage: Photographic grain only. No noise overlays, no patterns.

composition.hierarchy_method: Size and whitespace first, colour last
composition.flow_direction: Vertical with two deliberate horizontal interruptions (the pinned featured track and the marquee)
composition.grouping_strategy: Hairline-separated bands; a band is one idea

imagery.photo_treatment: Warm natural light, architecture-forward, no faces. On ink sections an ink gradient covers the bottom 40% so captions stay legible.
imagery.graphic_elements: Hairlines, the ME monogram, the scroll cue, mono index numbers
imagery.image_shape: Hard rectangles - 16:9 hero (9:16 or 4:5 on mobile), 4:5 and 3:2 cards, 3:4 plus 4:3 editorial pairs

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate and physical - a 0.98 press scale, a rule that grows, a label that shifts 2px
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Gated behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). Image scale, hairline growth, cursor-following imagery on lists.
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Slow and weighted on scroll reveals, crisp and sub-300ms in the UI
interaction_feel.loading_style: A first-visit preloader (max 1.8s, once per session) then a bronze hairline progress bar; skeletons are ivory-2 blocks with no shimmer
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low and consistent - the same three gestures reused everywhere

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, warm, expert. Serbian formal Vi.
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: A verb and its object, no arrow glyph in the label: Pogledajte nekretnine, Zakazite obilazak
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: State the fact, then offer the single most useful next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Plain, specific, never apologetic or cute

overview.performance_tier: mid - the landing must stay at 60fps on a mid-range phone; the 360 and splat viewers are the only heavy routes and they are lazy-loaded
overview.fallback_strategy: Every effect has a static final state. The gsap.matchMedia reduced branch paints it instantly, Lenis is never mounted under reduced motion, and the WebGL routes device-tier before downloading.
overview.primary_technology: GSAP 3.15 (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Flip, CustomEase) + Lenis 1.3; CSS transitions for UI

background_effects.description: A linear ink gradient over the bottom 40% of dark-section media, plus a hero overlay whose opacity scrubs 0.25 to 0.6 as the hero leaves
background_effects.technology: CSS gradient + one scrubbed GSAP tween on opacity

particle_systems.description: Deliberately absent - particles read as decoration and break the quiet-luxury brief

3d_elements.description: Per-listing immersive routes only, never on the landing. Spark 2 SplatMesh over three.js for the walkthrough, Photo Sphere Viewer 5 for panoramas.

params.camera: 1.6m eye height, 1.2 m/s walk, clamped to the floor polygon
params.geometry: PCSOGS splat scene; 4096x2048 panoramas with a 2048 mobile variant

scroll_effects.type: pinned horizontal track, parallax, clip-path reveals, hairline draws, scrubbed zoom
scroll_effects.description: Featured listings pin and translate horizontally at 1024px and up; images parallax at yPercent plus/minus 8; figures and imagery reveal with clip-path inset; rules draw 0 to 100%; the 3D-tour frame scales while pinned.
scroll_effects.technology: GSAP ScrollTrigger driven by Lenis through a single gsap.ticker raf

params.scrub: true only for parallax and pins
params.reduced: final state set instantly, no ScrollTrigger created

cursor_effects.type: cursor-following image reveal and a magnetic CTA
cursor_effects.description: Hovering a neighborhood row reveals a photograph that trails the pointer with gsap.quickTo; the primary CTA leans up to 8px toward the pointer. Desktop fine-pointer only.
cursor_effects.technology: gsap.quickTo inside useGSAP, gated by matchMedia

text_effects.description: SplitText lines rise from yPercent 110 behind an overflow-clip mask; the intro statement words scrub from 0.15 to 1 opacity.
text_effects.technology: GSAP SplitText with autoSplit, mask lines, aria auto, the tween created inside onSplit, after document.fonts.ready

svg_animations.type: hairline draw and the wordmark mask reveal
svg_animations.description: Dividers and the process spine draw their stroke on scroll; the preloader raises the wordmark letters behind a mask over a bronze progress rule.
svg_animations.technology: GSAP tweens on scaleX / clip-path (no DrawSVG needed for straight rules)

glassmorphism.description: Explicitly banned by docs/03-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md - blurred translucent panels read as generic AI output

transitions.description: A full-bleed ink panel wipes up over 0.6s between public routes, then lifts to reveal the new page. Skipped entirely under reduced motion.
transitions.technology: GSAP timeline on a fixed panel, driven by the next-intl pathname

visual_effects.composite_notes: The award-winning references lean on one pinned horizontal moment plus one cursor-driven list; both are reproduced. What is deliberately NOT reproduced: WebGL distortion on hover, scroll-jacked full-page sections, particles, and animated gradients - each of them fights the restraint the brief asks for, and three of them cost frames on a mid-range phone.
